summary: Iteration 7 — Full backend + frontend regression for new Savings Goal and Low-Balance-Alert features. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases passed (100%). All new /api/savings-goal endpoints work correctly: GET returns null when unset, PUT upserts and preserves the same id on subsequent updates (no duplicates), DELETE returns 200 (404 on second delete), validation blocks target<=0 and missing target with 422, and all three methods require auth (401 without token). Per-user isolation verified: user A's goal is invisible to user B and vice versa. Regression: negative-balance scenario (income=100, expense=250, savings=6000) yields income-expense=-150 while savings stays isolated at 6000. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x900): Overview empty-state 'set-savings-goal' card renders when no goal is set; adding savings=6000 and PUT-ing target=10000 shows the savings-goal-card with '60%' in savings-goal-percent; editing target to 20000 updates the ring to '30%'; removing the goal returns to the empty 'set-savings-goal' card. Low-balance-alert card is NOT rendered when balance >= 0 (₹100 after income only), and IS rendered as testID=low-balance-alert when balance goes negative — total-balance shows '-₹150'. Monthly Savings metric (₹6,000) is still displayed correctly and does not affect balance. No API failures, no red-screen errors.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Non-blocking on web preview; will show up in RN 0.76+ / new-arch native builds. Consider migrating shadow* → boxShadow in the affected StyleSheet entries in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow in index.tsx to silence the RN web deprecation warning.
(Optional / carried from iter6) server.py is 585 lines — still under 700, but plan to split auth/transactions/budgets/savings into modules soon.
critical_code_review_comments: SavingsGoal endpoints use upsert with $setOnInsert on id — clean and matches Budget pattern. Isolation via owner_id filter is correct.
SavingsGoal Pydantic model uses gt=0 constraint — validation returns 422 for zero/negative as expected.
GET /api/savings-goal returns Optional[SavingsGoal] which serializes to JSON null when absent — frontend correctly handles this to toggle empty state.

Frontend balance = income - expense (savings excluded) — matches spec. totalSavings for the ring is cumulative across all months (sum of all savings transactions), while the monthly 'Savings' metric is month-filtered — both correct per requirements.
Deprecated shadow* style warning appears on web preview only; not a functional issue.
seed_data_creation: Disposable users per test (prefixes: sga/sgb/bal/uisg + uuid). No production data touched. Frontend created one throwaway user via signup UI to run the full flow. QA account not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend base URL env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Backend expects username-based login. Savings goal target must be > 0 (422 otherwise). Frontend Overview screen renders SavingsGoalCard in place of the goal card (either empty 'set-savings-goal' or filled 'savings-goal-card' with 'savings-goal-percent'); low-balance-alert appears iff balance = income - expense < 0 (savings excluded). When automating add-transaction from a 390-wide viewport, the modal may exceed the visible viewport; use JS click (element.click()) via page.evaluate to bypass Playwright's viewport check on data-testid selectors — the app itself is not broken.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature validation run. Both new features (savings goal + low balance alert) match the spec exactly on backend and mobile web preview.
